newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.043pts to 103.504.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.043pts to 103.504.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.043 points in Friday's trading to 103.504 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.766 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.044 points to 101.025, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.379 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.199 points to 1,020.532.
